entries.msgstr: Smoke complicates spotting enemy vehicles and communicating their positions. Fire causes damage to vehicles.
Fog complicates spotting enemy vehicles and communicating their positions.
Heavy rain complicates spotting enemy vehicles and communicating their positions.
Sandstorms complicate spotting enemy vehicles and communicating their positions.
Smoke complicates spotting enemy vehicles and communicating their positions.
Vehicle and turret movement decreases <font color='#EE7000'>gun accuracy</font>
The circle around the reticle indicates <font color='#EE7000'>gun accuracy</font>. Wait a little for a more accurate shot.
<font color='#EE7000'>Auto-Aim</font> enabled. Click the right mouse button to cancel.
Auto-Aim always aims your gun <font color='#EE7000'>at the center</font> of your targeted vehicle
Your base is being <font color='#EE7000'>captured!</font> If not repelled, the enemy team will win the battle.
Each enemy vehicle has <font color='#EE7000'>its own</font> capture progress
<font color='#EE7000'>Capturing</font> the enemy base is one of the ways to win a battle
When you receive damage, your capture progress <font color='#EE7000'>is reset</font>
When you leave the base circle, your capture progress <font color='#EE7000'>is lost</font>
Multiple vehicles capture a base <font color='#EE7000'>faster</font>
After the <font color='#EE7000'>third</font> vehicle, base capture speed does not increase
Enemy base is almost captured!
Your team is winning the base capture race!
Vehicle module critically damaged! Repair it using <font color='#EE7000'>the Repair Kit</font> on the bottom panel.
Vehicle module critically damaged! Repair it using <font color='#EE7000'>the Repair Kit</font> on the bottom panel.
Crew member critically injured! Treat them with <font color='#EE7000'>the First Aid Kit</font> on the bottom panel.
Crew member critically injured! Treat them with <font color='#EE7000'>the First Aid Kit</font> on the bottom panel.
Vehicle crew stunned! Treat them with <font color='#EE7000'>the First Aid Kit</font> on the bottom panel.
Vehicle on fire! Use <font color='#EE7000'>the Fire Extinguisher</font> on the bottom panel.
Vehicle on fire! Automatic <font color='#EE7000'>Fire Extinguisher</font> activated.
Vehicle module critically damaged! Equipping <font color='#EE7000'>a Repair Kit</font> before battle helps deal with critical hits.
Crew member critically injured! Equipping <font color='#EE7000'>a First Aid Kit</font> before battle helps deal with crew injuries.
Vehicle on fire! Equipping <font color='#EE7000'>a Fire Extinguisher</font> before battle helps deal with fires.
You have been <font color='#EE7000'>spotted</font>—firing may reveal your position!
Your vehicle was destroyed. You can press <font color='#EE7000'>Esc</font> to leave the battle without penalty.
Your vehicle was destroyed. You can click the mouse button to <font color='#EE7000'>spectate</font> your allies.
The <font color='#EE7000'>lightbulb icon</font> indicates that you have been spotted by enemies!
Your gun is still <font color='#EE7000'>reloading</font>
Your gun can only be fired if the circle around the reticle is <font color='#EE7000'>completely green</font>
You can scroll the mouse wheel to enter <font color='#EE7000'>Sniper mode</font>
You can scroll the mouse wheel to <font color='#EE7000'>leave</font> Sniper mode
An <font color='#EE7000'>inner green reticle</font> indicates a high chance of penetrating the enemy's armor
Even when the inner reticle is green, armor penetration <font color='#EE7000'>is not guaranteed</font>
Guns are not 100% accurate, so shots may <font color='#EE7000'>not always land in the center</font> of the reticle
An inner reticle indicates the chance of penetrating enemy armor. <font color='#EE7000'>Enable it in Settings</font>.
